capabilities: Publish, save as draft or schedule the current note to Ghost
Upload local images and videos and rewrite their references to Ghost URLs
Sync a live post's status and details back into the note's properties
Move published notes to an archive folder
Show the note's Ghost status in the status bar
extras: Works on desktop and mobile; only images and MP4/WebM/OGV videos are uploaded, and the Ghost site's own upload size limit applies.
problem: Moving a note from Obsidian to Ghost otherwise means copying Markdown, re-uploading images by hand and re-entering tags, status and scheduling details.

relations.evidence: Publish your Obsidian notes directly to Ghost blogs

summary: Publishes Obsidian notes to a Ghost blog, uploading images and videos, converting Markdown to HTML, and syncing post details back to frontmatter.
